observations.body: Prophecy and tongues are weighed by understanding. Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy. However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

payload.posture: Read 1 Corinthians 14:1–19 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states prophecy and tongues are weighed by understanding. Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy. However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
